title: S5a: isopotential_partition@1, cytoplasmic_bridge_closure@1, scheduled_membrane_insertion@2 and restricted_cleft_lumen@2 against R-ops, R-tissue and the analytic limits
status: PROPOSED, not registered: drafted 14 November 2026 for the lead's review with the advisor; the lead's rulings of 14 November written in. No judged run has been made. Q2's judged seeds and its negative controls are frozen together in this commit, before R-ops' amended magnitudes (Appendix A.8, the increment form's term, pending in R-ops) land.

references.interface: validation/division/REFERENCES_USAGE.md; the adapters are built from it alone

rules.tolerances: Every tolerance number is computed from a development run named beside it (validation/division/s5_protocol.py draft); development runs are not judged.
rules.judged_run: once per item, after registration, from a fresh clean execution snapshot of main (validation/source_snapshot.py, no dirty patch). A failure is recorded and diagnosed, never retuned.

judge_entries.guard: validation/division/s5_protocol.registered, each entry's first call: it refuses an unregistered protocol and a source that is not a clean execution snapshot before anything is computed or written (S3's rule); tests/unit/test_s5_judged_refusal.py tests it on edited copies
judge_entries.Q2: python -m validation.division.q2_rops_comparison judge OUT (also refused until R-ops takes charge_term)
judge_entries.Q4, Q6-Q9: the test files at the judged snapshot

rules.landing_order: this protocol's frozen commit lands on main first, then the amended R-ops; A.8's 'pending in R-ops' is removed in that second landing (the lead, 14 November)
rules.pre_merge: runs marked pre_merge ran before main's merge of the volume ledger (08c6a10). S5's own crossrev set is identical across the merge (crossrev-s5a10-division against crossrev-s5a11), but it covers the nine compact worlds only; the egg-scale world and Q5's worlds are outside it, and the only merged source they execute (current_injection.py) changed by a declaration (CONFLICTS_VIEW volume).

Q2.claim: The engine's event map equals R-ops'.
cases: each world's events: the compact symmetric and asymmetric worlds, the neighbour contact, the bridge world's first and second divisions, the asymmetric furrow world with a bridge, the second-onset world's first division
the simultaneous second divisions as the engine applies them (bridge world, second-onset world), against R-ops applying them one after the other, in both orders

worlds: asymmetric neighbour world (f 0.75, a 0.6, three carriers): divided(neighbour=True, f=0.75, area_fraction=0.6, carriers={Na: 0.3, K: 0.5, M: 0.2})
random_sets.sampler: validation/division/q2_rops_comparison.perturbed, one fresh numpy default_rng per world and spread
random_sets.count_rule: every draw the composite's control domain check admits, with the control at the event, is compared; no other bound applies, no draw is redrawn, and the admitted counts are reported

seen.role: development evidence (q2_domain_probe's draws; their old-scale results were seen). Once the amended R-ops lands they are rerun under both scales (apply(..., charge_term=False) for the old) and disclosed

judged.role: the judged sets, assigned by the lead; read only by q2_rops_comparison.judge behind its guard. Nobody runs them, at either scale, before the judged run

Q2.tolerance: 64 eps x R-ops' own magnitude per compared quantity (the lead's ruling). For a cell's node charge, input and daughters alike, R-ops' magnitude adds |Q| + 1e-15 F sum |z dn|, the increment form's term (the lead's ruling of 14 November: not A.1's whole content, about 1,370 times larger on these draws), carried through its own solve (Appendix A.8, pending in R-ops); clefts unchanged. A key without an R-ops magnitude compares at 64 eps x (|engine| + |R-ops|).

a8_loosening.note: the references agent's measure of A.8's loosening (new/old per output key): every magnitude that depends on a charge or potential (charges, potentials, image charge, capacitor energy, and through delta q the mismatch, delta, the increments and moved amounts, the daughters' amounts, the free energy and W); volumes, backgrounds, anchors, areas and capacitances unchanged. The factor on Q2's own draws comes from the seen sets' rerun

negative_controls.frozen: with the judged seeds, in one commit (the lead, 14 November)

defects.a_k: R-ops given membrane_0's share a_k + delta; a patch's charge and capacitance split together, so it reaches the charges and never the potentials
defects.parent charge: R-ops given the parent's node charge Q_P + delta |Q_declared| (the snapshot's charge anchor), which does not vanish as Q_P nears 0
defects.f: R-ops given the volume fraction f + delta
defects.transference: R-ops given the first carrier's t + delta and the second's t - delta, their sum kept 1
defects.W: R-ops' daughters' free energy evaluated at V_D (1 + delta), a booking defect in the free-energy volume: W moves by -1e-3 RT N_D ln(1 + delta), first order (the amendment)
defects.image: the engine moves (1 + delta) times the mismatch, its carrier fractions scaled in its layout, which breaks isopotentiality at first order (an engine-side defect, since R-ops keeps the transference numbers summing to 1; the amendment); a delta its own event checks refuse is reported

negative_controls.statistic: per control and family, the smallest delta whose ratio passes 64 (None if none does; 'baseline above 64' where the undefected case already fails at that scale)
negative_controls.pass: every control's target families caught at or below the threshold wherever the undefected case passes; at the new scale each near-zero case passes undefected and fails with the parent-charge defect. A control that misses the threshold is a finding, never a moved threshold

amendment.when: the lead, 14 November, after the freeze (0c7e2ac) and before any new-scale run; the threshold stays 1e-9
amendment.finding: W is reached by no map defect at 1e-9: f at 1.0-1.8e-5 or never, transference at 3.2-5.6e-5, a_k at 1.0-1.8e-5, the parent charge at 1-1.8e-4 (old scale, protocol-dev-s5a23)
amendment.reason: dG is stationary at the correct split: at delta = 0 the daughters' concentrations equal the parent's, so d dG / d delta = ln c_D1 - ln c_D2 = 0, and any map defect reaches W only at second order. W equals dG here, the bath held at 0 V. f -> W was a mis-specified target
changes: W leaves f's targets; f's effect on W is reported as information
W takes its own first-order control (the daughters' free energy at V_D (1 + delta))
the image charge takes its own control (the mismatch scaled, delta -> (1 + delta) delta)

cases: the asymmetric neighbour world's bound state
the asymmetric furrow world after its onset (two patches a cell)

near_zero.rule: the asymmetric world's admitted seen draws whose parent patch lies within 0.005 V of 0 V before the event (a state-only rule)
near_zero.disclosure: the rule was chosen after the seen states had been seen: a 1 mV rule kept two draws (spread 1, draws 35 and 77); 5 mV adds seven more and the spread-3 worst (draw 32). The driver recomputes the members from the rule and asserts them
near_zero.judged_sets: the rule applies unchanged to the judged sets: at the judged run the near-zero cases are the judged sets' admitted draws within the same 5 mV (the lead, 14 November)

Q2.judged_run: q2_rops_comparison judge once at the judged snapshot, with R-ops' amended magnitudes: the cases, the simultaneous divisions, the judged sets and the controls under both scales; the verdict at the new scale

development_estimate.note: the a_k control at the new scale, estimated before R-ops lands: in every near-zero member a 1e-9 defect moves at least 1e-23 C of charge against a threshold of 1.2-4.1e-25 C, so it would be caught (an estimate, not a new-scale result)

development_at_the_freeze.note: the frozen controls before the amendment (old scale): their W finding led to it

development_findings: W is reached by no map defect at 1e-9 (old scale, protocol-dev-s5a23): f at 1.0-1.8e-5 or never, transference at 3.2-5.6e-5 or never, a_k at 1.0-1.8e-5, the parent charge at 1-1.8e-4. dG is stationary at the correct split, so a map defect reaches W only at second order; the lead removed W from f's targets and gave W and the image charge their own controls (negative_controls.amendment)
the amended W control is caught on W at 5.6e-13 in all 12 cases (old scale, protocol-dev-s5a25), and f on the amounts at 1.8e-14

a finding for the lead: the image control does not reach the image charge. A held node's plate charge is minus the total charge of the patches facing it; a split that conserves charge (the engine's always does, D2 taking the rest) leaves it unchanged, and so does the floating cleft's fixed charge in the furrow world. So the image target misses in 10 of 12 cases (never caught, or the undefected ratio above 64), and the two catches (seen spread 1 draws 35 and 180, at 1.8e-12 and 5.6e-13) sit where the undefected image ratio is near 64: rounding, not a reach. The image control reaches the potentials at 1.8e-14-1e-13 and the charges at 3.2-5.6e-13 where measurable. The engine's own event checks refuse it from 3.2e-9 to 1.8e-7. Target unchanged, threshold unmoved

the engine does not output delta q or delta separately: the transference control reaches them through the increments and moved amounts (caught at 1.0-1.8e-13 old scale); free-energy changes are observed only within W
no map defect reaches the image charge, zero in exact arithmetic for an isopotential split, and nor does the amendment's image control (above)

at the old scale the near-zero cases' undefected potentials (and draw 35's charges) exceed 64, so those families read 'baseline above 64' there; where measurable the parent charge is caught on the charges at 3.2e-16-5.6e-15

before_the_freeze.note: the same cases and seen sets at the old scale (fixed 0.39; simultaneous 0.088 and 0.33; symmetric 0.81, 0.93, 0.68; asymmetric 9.06, 860.56, 152.62), with the earlier controls (a_k and |Q_P|-scaled parent charge only)

out_of_domain_94.7.note: uncompensated increments; the states pass @3's bare domain check but fail the composite's control domain check in 197 of 200 (the gating laws' voltage domains) and the dropped 10% band in all 200. Cause: the engine forms charges in increment form, and its rounding scales with the increments' ionic content.

rounding_cause.note: |engine - R-ops| scales with the increments' ionic content at fixed net charge: median ratio 9.3-10.0 at 10x and 96-112 at 100x (asymmetric world); A.1's whole content is about 1,370 times the increments'.

Q3.claim: Trajectories after partition agree with R-tissue.
Q3.worlds: quartered furrow (cleft_quartered, passive, 1 pA into d1) and neighbour contact (asymmetric f 0.75, a 0.6, three mismatch carriers, the contact's gate fixed open, 1 pA into d1); validation/division/q3_tissue_comparison.py
Q3.records: strictly after each division instant and off the onset instants
Q3.quantities: each live cell's Vm; each lumen's volume and composition; the bridge current; each contact's current in R-tissue's direction
Q3.engine_step_term_rule: |Q(0.25 ms) - Q(0.125 ms)| per quantity and record
Q3.reference_term_rule: |R-tissue(SMALL atol) - R-tissue(SMALL x 1e-3)| per quantity and record
Q3.tolerance_rule: 3 x (step + reference) per quantity and record; where both terms fall below it, the floor 64 eps x the quantity's scale (its largest |value| over the world's records, the engine's at the judged step) serves instead
Q3.verdict_rule: pass when every |engine - R-tissue| at each record is within its tolerance

Q4.claim: The analytic limits (design §7.3) hold, each to its stated tolerance.
limits: symmetric division at the event: daughters bitwise half the parent, moved transfers and the chemical work exact zeros, the capacitor term within 1e-14 of 1/2 C (0.1 V)^2 (test_partition.py)
symmetric trajectories: every field and potential of d1 and d2 within 64 eps of its scale for 50 ms (test_division_limits_runs.py)
asymmetric division: increments to 1e-12, Q_D1 = a q to 1e-12, the unmixing work RT sum delta^2 / (2 n f (1 - f)) to 1e-3 and >= 0 (test_partition.py)
isopotential split: the daughters at the parent's potential to 1e-12 (test_partition.py)
open bridge: its conductance 2 a sigma_cyt to 1e-3, and 1 - V2/V1 = R_b / (Rm + R_b) to 1% at 0.25 ms (test_bridge_closure_runs.py)
closed bridge (a = 0): the trans-cleft T-network's coupling, cleft ratio and input resistance to 1%, and the bridge-free world's response to 1e-9 (test_division_limits_runs.py)
sealed cleft (A/L = 0): R_j = 1/G_f1 + 1/G_f2 = 2 r_new / A_face to 1%, the coupling to 1% (test_division_limits_runs.py)

changes: every membrane permeability x 100: each patch keeps its reversal potential, and the membrane time constant goes from about 1.5 s to 15 ms, so the limit is reached in a short run
no insertion after the division: the geometry holds still
the access face's area 1.5e-13 m^2: its resistance comparable with a furrow's
circuit_world.base: S5's compact furrow world (cleft_divided, symmetric, passive)
